dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures featuring high-contrast light-colored perimeters; geometry consists of sharp boundaries between the dark base pelt and the light ring, with several prominent structures containing dark interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid light-toned pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal ridge and scattered across the posterior flank, appearing as high-frequency points without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary cluster of three large macro-annuli on the mid-lateral flank forms an elongated scalene triangle; a secondary configuration of four high-intensity blobs near the dorsal-posterior junction forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, interconnected network of light-intensity pixel boundaries on the anterior-dorsal region forms a map-like lattice pattern where individual annuli merge.
